title: Opinion phrases and task
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 40 (Pupil PDF worksheet: opinion phrases and task)
intro: Lesson 40: Which do I prefer and why? Opinions with reasons. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
أُفَضِّلُ السَّكَنَ فِي المَدِينَةِ عَلَى الرِّيفِ لِأَنَّ فِيهَا مَسَاجِدَ وَمَدَارِسَ كَثِيرَةً.
مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الرِّيفَ أَجْمَلُ.
لَوْ كُنْتُ أَسْكُنُ فِي الرِّيفِ لَمَشَيْتُ فِي الطَّبِيعَةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.

head: Not this
This
rows: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الرِّيفَ أَجْمَلُ (ism of أَنَّ is mansub)

keywords.def: on one hand ... on the other

questions.q: Give your preference with two reasons.
questions.a: e.g. أُفَضِّلُ الرِّيفَ عَلَى المَدِينَةِ لِأَنَّهُ هَادِئٌ وَلِأَنَّ الهَوَاءَ نَقِيٌّ.

questions.q: Exam-style task (our own) in the portal response box: 'أَيْنَ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَسْكُنَ فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟' 80 words with an opinion, two reasons, a contrast and a conditional or future.
questions.a: Justified answer with the required structures

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer
A) أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ المَدِينَةَ مُزْدَحِمَةٌ. Ism of أَنَّ mansub; khabar marfu'.

questions.q: Think again: what does the examiner want?
